title: Popular BBC paranormal podcast bringing spooky show to West Yorkshire
excerpt: A PARANORMAL podcast is set to get pulses racing as it embarks on its first-ever arena tour
content:
A PARANORMAL podcast is set to get pulses racing as it embarks on its first-ever arena tour.

Uncanny, the BBC podcast and TV series hosted by Danny Robins, has announced a live UK and Ireland arena tour for autumn 2027, including a show at the First Direct Bank Arena in Leeds on Tuesday, November 2.

Mr Robins said: "I still pinch myself on a daily basis when I think about the way Uncanny has grown.

"This podcast that I started a few years ago, recording in my shed, is now hitting the road to play an arena tour.

"It’s like the maddest, potentially paranormal, cheese dream.

"I love the fact that I get to talk about this fascinating subject to an audience of people who are just as interested in ghosts as I am, and now, we are doing it on a bigger scale than we’ve ever done it before."

The live show will delve into new, never-before-heard paranormal cases with a mix of storytelling, expert analysis, and audience interaction.

Mr Robins will be joined on stage by returning experts Dr Ciaran O’Keeffe and Evelyn Hollow, as they investigate unexplained experiences and invite the audience to decide for themselves whether they are "Team Sceptic or Team Believer."

The tour begins in Aberdeen on Friday, October 22, and concludes in Dublin on Friday, November 12.

Each night promises a blend of chills, humour, and intrigue, as well as the opportunity for audience members to share their own ghost stories and questions live.

Mr Robins said: "I’ve had a great time doing the last two Uncanny tours around the theatres of the UK, but making the leap to arenas allows me to deliver a show that’s even more spooktacular and thrilling – expect something unlike anything you have seen before.

"It’ll make you jump, laugh and question the very nature of the universe as we try to solve that biggest of all mysteries – do ghosts exist?

"I can’t wait to see you at one of our dates on tour – and to maybe hear your stories too?"

Uncanny has attracted millions of listeners since launching in 2021 and has since expanded into a BBC Two television series and two sold-out theatre tours.
